part_5_effect_on_the_recorded_gap.statement: Including tests/test_p4_2a_v2_heldout_finalizer.py in the archive and Merkle coverage means that this one test can no longer be modified without a gate noticing. That closes the gap for this path only.
part_5_effect_on_the_recorded_gap.still_open: The control surface otherwise contains 17 scripts and no tests, so every other test file remains modifiable without detection. F-8 stays open and a principled rule for test registration still belongs in a later pre-registration, not in this correction.

part_6_meta_observation.statement: This is the third consecutive narrow authorization required to advance one step: the successor v2.1 code gate, then the scope correction, then this control-plane expansion. Each was individually correct and each was requested rather than assumed.
part_6_meta_observation.assessment: The cost is real and is being paid honestly. It is the direct consequence of a regime where an approval that is not machine-enforceable is treated as not yet in force, which is the property that has repeatedly prevented silent drift in this phase. No loosening is proposed.
part_6_meta_observation.watch: If a fourth authorization becomes necessary before the rehearsal runs, that is a signal the v2.1 pre-registration under-specified its own surface, and the remedy is a better pre-registration next time rather than faster approvals now.
